# Team brief: Linkshelf command palette and ask panel

## Problem

Power users want to jump to any saved link or action from the keyboard, and to ask questions about their saved links in a side panel where an assistant streams an answer with the links it used.

## Draft acceptance criteria

- AC-1 (draft): pressing the shortcut opens a palette that filters links and actions as the user types.
- AC-2 (draft): the ask panel streams an answer and lists the links it drew on.
- AC-3 (draft): before the assistant archives links on the user's behalf it shows what it will do and waits for approval.

## Constraints

- React with Tailwind and shadcn/ui components.

## What exists

New project.

## Questions for each specialist

- frontend: components for the palette, the streaming answer, and the approval step.

# Team brief: Linkshelf reading board

## Problem

Users want a board with three columns (To read, Reading, Done) and to move a link between columns by dragging it, with the mouse or the keyboard.

## Draft acceptance criteria

- AC-1 (draft): a link can be dragged from one column to another and stays there after reload.
- AC-2 (draft): the same move can be made with the keyboard alone.

## Constraints

- React with Tailwind and shadcn/ui components.

## What exists

New project.

## Questions for each specialist

- frontend: how the board and the drag interaction are built.
